boxes.name: Engine Compartment Fuse Block
fuses: INT LPS - Trunk/courtesy/vanity/glove box lamps, garage door opener, courtesy lamp relay
CIG LTR1 - Front cigarette lighter, rear lighter
CIG LTR2 - Right and left rear cigarette lighters
L HDLP LO - Left low-beam headlamp
R HDLP LO - Right low-beam headlamp, headlamp switch LED
L HDLP HI - Left high-beam headlamp
R HDLP HI - Right high-beam headlamp
HDLPS - Headlamp switch and relays, high/low beam control
HAZARD - Flasher module, turn/hazard module, turn and back-up lamps
STOP - Stoplamp switch, CHMSL, ABS controller, cruise control, rear stoplamps
MIRROR - Inadvertent power relay, outside mirror, DLC, flash-to-pass module
FOG/DRL - DRL relay, fog lamp relay, headlamp switch, front fog lamps
IGN 1 - Rear ignition-1/fog lamp/rear lamp/controlled power back-up/DRL relays
WIPERS - Accessory relay, wiper switch, cluster, wiper motor and pump
FUEL PUMP - Oil pressure indicator, PCM, fuel pump relay, fuel pump
CRUISE - Cruise control, PNP switch, back-up lamps, electrochromatic mirror, BTSI
ECS - Shift solenoids, MAF, canister purge, PCM, EGR, PS switch, front ignition-1 relay
A/C COMP - A/C compressor relay, cooling fan relays 1-3, compressor

boxes.name: MaxiFuse/Relay Center
fuses: BODY 1 - RTD/convenience/BATT/headlamp wash/antenna fuses, park lamp relay
BODY 2 - Defog relay, pull-down/heated seat/ELC/rear defog/heated mirror fuses
BODY 3 - Controlled power relays, PZM/radio/cluster/amp/comfort fuses
INADVERT - Inadvertent power relay, blower motor, interior lamps/lighter fuses
LAMPS - High/low beam and headlamp relays, lighting fuses, stop fuse
IGN 1 - Rear ignition-1 relay, wiper/relay ignition-1/SIR fuses
SEATS - Horn relay, lumbar relays, memory seat module, power seat switches
BATT 3 - Ignition 0 fuses, RTD, ABS, turn fuse, console
BATT 2 - Starter enable relay, crank/injector/ECS/PCM/DIS/ignition-1/ACC fuses
IGN 1 - Front ignition-1 relay, O2 sensor/fuel/cruise fuses
BATT 1 - Starter relay, PCM fuse, A/C compressor fuse

boxes.name: Rear Compartment Fuse Block
fuses: RLY IGN1 - SDM, cluster, cruise, brake switch, PZM, fuel level sensor
IGN 0-BODY - PRNDL, heated windshield, PZM, cluster, ACM, HVAC, rear defog/ELC relays
TURN - Cornering lamps, flasher module, turn/hazard switch, turn signal lamps
CONSOLE - Phone docking station, washer board, heated seat switches, rear zone blower
COMFORT - CD player, RFA, controlled power relay, ACM, PZM
RADIO/PHONE - Radio, RIM, phone, DAB/trunk/fuel door release/high beam relays
ACC - PZM, electrochromic mirror, rain sensor, accessory relay
HTD SEAT R - Passenger heated seat relay
HTD SEAT L - Driver heated seat relay
HDLP WASH - Headlamp wash relay and motor
CONVENC - Trunk/fuel door release, door lock/unlock relays and motors
BATT - Seat lumbar switches, memory seat module
RT PARK - Park lamps, right sidemarkers, headlamp switch, rear fog relay
LT PARK - Left sidemarkers, parking lamps, license lamp, underhood lamp
